many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# ARC marker-centered square rings

1. Identify the square's frame and the single extra marker cell (often color 3); treat the open square including its frame-edge notch as the fill region, preserving all existing frame cells and the marker.
2. For every blank cell inside the square, calculate Chebyshev distance from the marker: `d = max(abs(row - marker_row), abs(col - marker_col))`.
3. Recolor distance-1 cells with 4, distance-2 with 2, distance-3 with 4, and continue alternating (odd distances 4, even distances 2). Clip rings naturally to the square boundary; leave outside cells and frame unchanged.
4. Validate that the marker remains intact, colors alternate by Chebyshev-distance layer even when rings are clipped by an edge, and dimensions are unchanged; output exactly one valid action JSON object on the last line."
